entries_when.name: entries_when
entries_when.value:
case "entries"."when_kind"
        when 'part' then "entries"."when_part" is not null and "entries"."when_time" is null
        when 'day' then "entries"."when_part" is null and "entries"."when_time" is null
        else "entries"."when_time" is not null and "entries"."when_part" is null end

entries_kind.name: entries_kind
entries_kind.value:
case "entries"."kind"
        when 'food' then "entries"."via" is not null and "entries"."activity_id" is null and "entries"."kcal" is null and not "entries"."kcal_manual"
        else "entries"."activity_id" is not null and "entries"."via" is null and "entries"."combo_id" is null end

entries_combo_kind.name: entries_combo_kind
entries_combo_kind.value: ("entries"."combo_id" is null) = ("entries"."combo_kind" is null) and ("entries"."combo_kind" is null or "entries"."combo_kind" = 'combo')

labels_provenance.name: labels_provenance
labels_provenance.value: case when "labels"."verified" then "labels"."origin" is null or "labels"."origin" in ('open-food-facts', 'online') else "labels"."origin" is not null end
